areas.name: stock_link
areas.doc: The stock link: the glass a Mark made consumes, booked at the stock sheet; the day's usage sheet; the glass catalogue; and the retry queue that keeps a booking the stock sheet could not take. Moved out of copilot.py with the stock move (the stock area holds it now); its routes (the day sheet) are in gizmo/routes/stock_link.py. Read as `stock_link.NAME`.

routes.name: routes_stock_link
routes.doc: The day's stock usage sheet: what the bench used, reviewed and sent to the stock sheet. Gathered from add_routes with the stock move where the first stood; their paths are literal, so no request changes hands.
routes.register_doc: Add the stock usage sheet's routes to the app.
routes.comment: The stock usage sheet's routes (gizmo/routes/stock_link.py), gathered where the first stood.
